language.title: Language
language.hint: Pages, answers and checkpoints follow this language. Lesson titles stay in their original language.

sections.notice: The language above is saved. The switches below are not yet: they show what will be adjustable, do not change anything, and reset when you leave.

replies.label: When someone replies to you
replies.hint: A reply to your contribution, or a mention by name.

endorsed.label: When your work is endorsed
endorsed.hint: Someone who maintains the Space marked your contribution as trustworthy.

newLessons.label: New Lessons in Spaces you have starred
newLessons.hint: Off by default. A busy Space can publish several a week, and this is the one that turns a useful inbox into noise.

publicProfile.label: Public profile
publicProfile.hint: Your name, rank and published contributions are visible to anyone in a Space you share. Turning this off does not retract work you have already published.

activity.label: Show what I am reading
activity.hint: Lets members of a Space see which Lessons you have open. Off by default — nobody asked to be watched.

spaces.label: Show me to the people in my Spaces
spaces.hint: Your name, picture and XP appear in their rankings and on the Space. Off: only your friends see you there.
spaces.failed: That did not save. Try again.

export.label: Export everything
export.hint: Your notes, contributions and uploads as one archive. Nothing here is locked in.
export.notWiredHint: Export is designed but not built in this version.

delete.label: Delete your account
delete.hint: Removes your notes and uploads. Contributions you published to a Space stay, unattributed — deleting them would tear holes in Lessons other people rely on.

sections.motion: Motion follows your system setting for reduced motion — both the animated transitions and the hover effects. There is no switch here because there is nothing for it to disagree with.
